name: codex-cursor-bridge
description: Plan in Codex, execute in Cursor: validated handoff plans, background execution jobs with permission profiles, and diff review. Independent interoperability plugin; not affiliated with OpenAI or Cursor.

interface.longDescription: Produce validated implementation plans in Codex and delegate execution to Cursor agents through managed background jobs with permission profiles, worktree isolation, and diff review.
